column2: mature peptide of pp1a, not a fragment: nsp1 is released by its own PCPalpha/beta autoprotease (PMID 19553313). Partial-of-ORF1A at high identity is the DEFINING property of every nsp, so the FRAGMENT test cannot discriminate here. Discriminated instead by (a) junction chemistry -- every member begins M and ends G at the measured autoproteolytic site -- and (b) the literature length window in length_refs.json, both applied in build_collections.py before this audit ran.

mature peptide of pp1a, the largest one. Its C-terminus is released by PLP2, nsp2's own papain-like cysteine protease, which cleaves G|G (PMID 11602729). Partial-of-ORF1A at 100% identity is the DEFINING property of every nsp, so the FRAGMENT test cannot discriminate here; discriminated instead by junction chemistry and the literature window 700-1400 aa, applied at bin time. n=964: 409 deposits retained, plus 555 members re-derived from the genomes on the nsp1beta/nsp3 adjacency and the PLP2 G|G site (nsp2fix/extract_nsp2_nsp3.py, 21 Nov 2026). 229 deposits ending in Isoleucine were dropped to nsp2fix/NSP2.dropped_Iterm.faa: PLP2 cleaves after Gly, so an Ile terminus is a submitter ORF convention, not a cleavage product, and those members were clipping the profile 216 codons short at an internal LPG|GARY site. All 555 extracted members end in Gly.

mature peptide of pp1a. Its N-terminus is the PLP2 G|G site and its C-terminus the nsp4 3CLSP cut after Glu (PMID 11602729). n=543: 8 deposits plus 535 re-derived on the same adjacency as NSP2. All 535 extracted members start Gly and end Glu, matching all 8 deposits exactly -- independent confirmation of the NSP2 repair from the opposite end of the junction. Literature window 200-350 aa enforced at bin time.
